instruction: Can you disable the minimal view setting in VLC? I want to see all the controls and menu options available rather than having a streamlined interface.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
